metadata.name: trajectory-power-phase6-small-n-magnitude
metadata.intent: Phase 6 small-n paper-grade study, magnitude profile: Type I and power of the delta / angle / shape RRPP tests for the magnitude mode (joint construction) at the SEA-AD MTG astrocyte design (three stages; donor table F 11/10/28, M 9/10/12; methylation + expression measured; pooled PLS with stage-supervised double-CV rank), 500 replicates x 999 permutations, across a four-column design grid (>=30 / >=50 nuclei x two / three blocks). The Phase 4 gate is declared as advisory acceptance (design D6): the binding output is the findings report's per-statistic interpretability statement.

effect_axis.0.0: shared zero-effect anchor (byte-identical datasets to the pilot's and the sibling profile's anchor at the same replicate index)
effect_axis.0.02: start of the measured rise (pilot delta power 0.09)
effect_axis.1.0: control stress point for magnitude/angle and magnitude/shape (pilot 0.01 / 0.00)
effect_axis.dropped: 0.005 and 0.01 measured at the anchor's rate (0.05 / 0.04)

notes: Split profile (spec 'Phase 6 small-n study profiles', split rule): the pilot found magnitude's delta rise in e = 0.02-0.25 while orientation and shape move only in 0.50-1.00, at the relocation construction's ceiling (fraction clamped at 1.0). This profile carries the magnitude axis; phase6_small_n_study.json carries orientation, shape and translation. Both share generator, evaluation, base_seed 800 and the matched-seed family phase6-small-n with the pilot, so the shared zero-effect anchors are the same datasets in every profile.

generator and evaluation are copied from phase6_small_n_pilot.json; only evaluation.permutations rises from 199 to 999. n_samples, stage_sample_prop and group_ratio stay absent (group_stage_sizes fixes every cell).

Design grid: generator.group_stage_sizes x evaluation.integration_params.layers. The engine crosses design-grid axes, so there are four columns: baseline (>=30 nuclei, methylation + expression), >=50 nuclei [[10, 9, 25], [9, 9, 12]] on two blocks, >=30 nuclei on all three blocks (layers null = key absent), and >=50 nuclei on three blocks (accepted 2026-10-09 in place of an explicit-points engine mode). Read the cohort-size contrast as baseline vs >=50 nuclei at two blocks and the block-count contrast as baseline vs three blocks at n = 80; columns differing only in layers evaluate the same generated datasets.

Gate reduced to the magnitude rules, as in the Phase 5 re-measurement: magnitude/delta mandatory power, magnitude/angle and magnitude/shape mandatory control, control_modes [none]. Advisory (design D6).
Report contract copied from phase5_power_study.json. Attribution is disabled here (orientation attribution lives in the sibling profile). Do not pass --n-jobs; the contract forbids it.

Cells and cost: 2 Type I baselines + 4 columns x (1 anchor + 6 effects) = 30 cells, 15,000 units. Pilot median 8.0 s per unit at 199 permutations; planning figure 10 s at 999 permutations -> about 42 core-hours, 50 with a 20% contention margin. Pin BLAS to one thread.
